raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` is currently used to select the weight layout (preshuffled vs plain) for every layer. With preshuffled layout, ASM gemm is used for prefill and preshuffled Triton gemm for decode. 

In previous PRs, attempted to remove the environment variable altogether and default to on, but caused regressions because various models (Kimi, DS) do not have tuned preshuffled Triton decode kernels. Ideally we would like to have this active for the models that it helps (Llama, mostly) without the environment variable. 

This PR removes the environment variable and decides per layer at weight-load time. A layer takes the preshuffled (ASM) layout only when aiter has tuned configs for both the ASM and Triton preshuffled kernels. 

## Testing

### Unit tests

```
python -m pytest tests/kernels/quantization/test_rocm_mxfp4.py
59 passed
```

### Serving setup

MI350X ×8, fresh server per arm, two restarts per arm. "Before" is `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM=0` on main.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve $MODEL -tp $TP --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --disable-uvicorn-access-log --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 16384 --load-format dummy

vllm bench serve --model $MODEL --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --temperature 0 \
  --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --max-concurrency $C --num-prompts $((4 * C))
# C = 1 4 8 16 32 64 128 for Llama-3.3-70B (min 8 prompts); C = 1 (8 prompts) and 32 (192 prompts) for the other models
```

### Serving: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-MXFP4 (change vs. today's default)

Layers on ASM: TP1 4/4 shapes, TP2 1/4 (aiter has no a4w4 tuned rows for the other three), TP4 4/4, TP8 4/4.

| TP | conc | TTFT (before → after) | TPOT | E2EL | tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | 1 | 54 → 45 ms (−18%) | −4.1% | −4.2% | +4.4% |
| 8 | 4 | 120 → 96 ms (−20%) | −5.1% | −5.3% | +5.6% |
| 8 | 8 | 208 → 167 ms (−20%) | −5.8% | −6.1% | +6.5% |
| 8 | 16 | 375 → 309 ms (−18%) | +6.4% | +5.2% | −5.0% |
| 8 | 32 | 562 → 458 ms (−18%) | +2.0% | +0.6% | −0.6% |
| 8 | 64 | 810 → 660 ms (−18%) | −6.9% | −7.7% | +8.3% |
| 8 | 128 | 1231 → 970 ms (−21%) | −3.7% | −5.1% | +5.3% |
| 4 | 1 | 77 → 50 ms (−36%) | −9.8% | −10.0% | +11.1% |
| 4 | 4 | 189 → 137 ms (−28%) | −10.2% | −10.5% | +11.8% |
| 4 | 8 | 353 → 266 ms (−24%) | −10.0% | −10.6% | +11.8% |
| 4 | 16 | 678 → 534 ms (−21%) | +1.9% | +0.2% | −0.2% |
| 4 | 32 | 1041 → 811 ms (−22%) | +4.3% | +1.7% | −1.7% |
| 4 | 64 | 1586 → 1195 ms (−25%) | −7.9% | −9.5% | +10.5% |
| 4 | 128 | 2286 → 1754 ms (−23%) | −10.7% | −12.0% | +13.6% |
| 2 | 1–128 | −2% to −3% | −0.9% to +1.0% | ±0.9% | ±0.9% |
| 1 | 1 | 221 → 53 ms (−76%) | −6.9% | −8.1% | +8.8% |
| 1 | 4 | 778 → 152 ms (−80%) | −8.4% | −12.5% | +14.3% |
| 1 | 8 | 1603 → 290 ms (−82%) | −9.1% | −16.9% | +20.4% |
| 1 | 16 | 3311 → 593 ms (−82%) | −6.2% | −21.1% | +26.7% |
| 1 | 32 | 4741 → 943 ms (−80%) | +11.0% | −8.6% | +9.4% |
| 1 | 64 | 7161 → 1515 ms (−79%) | −0.9% | −17.1% | +20.6% |
| 1 | 128 | 9103 → 2178 ms (−76%) | −26.6% | −34.8% | +53.3% |

- TTFT is lower at every concurrency and TP.
- Preshuffled Triton GEMM that is slower than plain triton for M 16-31 with current aiter configs. This creates the one material E2E loss at TP8 c16 (+5.2%). Elsewhere E2EL is at most +1.7% worse and usually 4–35% better.

### Serving: other models (TP8, change vs. today's default)

| Model | layers on ASM | c1 TTFT | c1 E2EL | c32 TTFT | c32 E2EL | c32 tok/s | ASM forced for comparison |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3.2-mxfp4 | 0/4 | −1% | ±0 | −2% | ±0 | ±0 | c32 TPOT +8.7%, tok/s −7.7% |
| DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4 | 0/4 | 0% | ±0 | −1% | ±0 | ±0 | c1 TPOT +10.6%, tok/s −9.4% |
| Kimi-K2.6-MXFP4 | 0/4 | −2% | ±0 | +1% | ±0 | ±0 | c32 TPOT +9.2%, tok/s −8.1% |
| MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 | 0/2 | +1% | ±0 | 0% | ±0 | ±0 | c32 TPOT +4.2%, tok/s −3.9% |
| Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-MXFP4 | 0/4 | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | 0% | c1 TPOT +24%, c32 tok/s −6.8% |
| Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4 | no MXFP4 dense linears | – | – | – | – | – | – |

- Stay on plain Triton as intended; e2e avoids the regression seen with ASM forced. 

**Llama-3.1-405B with tuned aiter configs.** AITER currently has no tuned preshuffled configs for 405B's TP8 shapes, but [incoming AITER PR](https://github.com/ROCm/aiter/pull/6546) with new tuned configs will improve it as well. 
| Llama-3.1-405B MXFP4 TP8 | c1 TTFT | c1 E2EL | c32 TTFT | c32 TPOT | c32 E2EL | c32 tok/s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| this PR + tuned aiter configs | −27% | −5.4% | −20% | −4.5% | −6.0% | +6.3% |

### Accuracy (GSM8K flexible-extract, 250 problems, ±~0.018)

| Model | before | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-MXFP4 | 0.916 | 0.920 |
| DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4 | 0.972 | 0.968 |
| Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-MXFP4 | 0.964 | 0.964 |
| Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct-MXFP4 + tuned aiter configs | 0.964 | 0.964 |

GPQA / AIME25 for Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-MXFP4 (TP8, chat template, greedy, `max_gen_toks=32768`):

| Task | before | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| GPQA diamond (CoT, 0-shot, flexible-extract) | 0.414 ± 0.035 | 0.424 ± 0.035 |
| AIME25 (exact match) | 0.033 (1/30) | 0.033 (1/30) |

---

AI assistance (Claude) was used to write and test this change. All changes reviewed.

I see. I haven't seen a better solution to this yet, other PR's do a similar thing.

This could be a good place for a microbenchmark to make sure this change of defaults make sense. I.e. for some common model shapes, check whether a GEMM that's tuned for m=1k,8k still beats the fallback GEMM on most m's.

(It most likely is the case I would guess: if you tune a GEMM for a particular weight shape then you tune it for most m's anyways. So if it's tuned for a some m's then it's most likely tuned for "all" m's)
